taxonomy.strongest_oracle_rule: A test receives the strongest grade among its direct assertions; an exit assertion does not downgrade a test that also checks content.
taxonomy.self_confirming_snapshot_rule: A snapshot regenerated by the code under test is downgraded to NO-CRASH-ONLY because both actual and expected share the same defect.
